title: The Bootstrap Utility API
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of the bootstrap utility api and when it is appropriate.
Apply understanding utility generation using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check the $utilities map and identify one likely failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study the bootstrap utility api and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: The Bootstrap Utility API is a customization capability. Prefer built-in utilities first, then CSS variables for local changes, and Sass/build customization only when the design needs generated framework changes.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating the bootstrap utility api as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
